figures.label: <fig_taxonomy>
figures.caption: The Emender head-type taxonomy:eigenvalue placement×saturation.(A)Each head is fixed by where its along-keyeigenvalue sits in the complex unit disk— real-positivedecay,real-negativereflect, or complexrot— and by whether the statemap is linear or saturated. The orange real diameter is the locusGDN-2 occupies.(B)The two axes name five cells. Shading marksGDN-2-adjacent linear cores; the Emender also explores off-axisrotation(rot) and saturated state maps(nonlin) as a within-layerpool. This taxonomy is descriptive:different decay placementprevents an exact equal-parameter restriction of the production cores.rot-nonlinis reserved for future work. The GDN-2 corner of this grid isthe mixer of the 1.3 B linear baseline of(GDN2), selected by the same search protocol as E97.

figures.label: <fig_arch>
figures.caption: Emender architecture and multi-programmed shape.(A)Per-head recurrent dataflow(E97). Each head owns a small boundedassociative matrix memory. The model reads under the gated address⊙,computes a prediction erroragainst the gated write value,writes the bounded deltacorrection into, and gates the read atfor output. Theon the state, the delta-correcting write, the split erase/writegates, and the-normalization ofq,kare visible here;enumerates thefour load-bearing ingredients of the Emender family.(B)The 1.3 B stack exposes 216 smallindependent heads per layer per batch element. Each head is a32×32state tile that fits in registers/SRAM and runs itstime loop serially; parallelism is harvested across heads, depth andbatch(), giving11×216×4=9{,}504programs per tokenat batch size 4.

figures.caption: Matched-token loss comparison(nats/token, The Pile).The commonlogged cutoff is step 2,300,925, five steps before the E97 checkpoint. At thematched cutoff the two arms sit within0.010nats/token smoothed(≈0.4%relative), and thesign of the gap depends on theaveraging window:GDN2 is lower on the full-trajectory and1,000-step windows, E97 is lower on the most recent 100-stepwindow. Early in training(5.1 B tokens) GDN2 led by 0.071nats; the gap closed as training progressed.
